hiddenInfoSafetyReview.notes: Corp-operation semantics are public when played, except private Corp choices such as R&D reorder, Archives recovery or ICE rearrange that remain Corp-side until resolved through existing legal public outputs.
AI025 adds no WebSocket, reconnect, undo-preview, replay, PublicEvents, log, client-error, planner or Targeting-AI projection path.

deferredItems.rationale: Multi-step installs, score-window advancement, R&D topdeck reorder, hidden Archives recovery, ICE rearrange/conceal and X-value future-action choices remain report-only until side-safe TargetProfile schema support exists.
Extra actions and install bundles receive function signals, but no new generic Corp tempo or operation strategy is introduced in AI025.
